title: MRI Feature Block

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: mri_feature_block_heading
fields.instructions: Use concise, benefit-led copy that is specific to the page audience and consistent with approved MRI messaging.
fields.default_value: One platform. More control across your portfolio.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.name: mri_feature_block_subheading
fields.instructions: Use concise, benefit-led copy that is specific to the page audience and consistent with approved MRI messaging.
fields.default_value: Open and connected real estate software

fields.label: Content
fields.name: mri_feature_block_content
fields.instructions: Use concise, benefit-led copy that is specific to the page audience and consistent with approved MRI messaging.
fields.default_value: Unify leasing, property management, accounting and operations while keeping the flexibility to connect the specialist tools your business needs.

fields.label: Button Label
fields.name: mri_feature_block_button_label
fields.instructions: Use a specific action that tells visitors what happens next, such as “Request a demo” or “Explore the solution”.

fields.label: Button Link
fields.name: mri_feature_block_button_link
fields.instructions: Use a stable, approved MRI Software URL. Prefer the canonical destination over a temporary tracking link.

fields.label: Image
fields.name: mri_feature_block_image
fields.instructions: Select an approved MRI image from the media library. Use imagery that supports this section rather than repeating nearby content.

fields.label: Reverse Columns
fields.name: mri_feature_block_reverse_columns
fields.instructions: Use this display option only when it improves the page layout and has been checked across screen sizes.

fields.label: Feature Points
fields.name: mri_feature_block_feature_points
fields.instructions: Add enough items to explain the story clearly. Keep item length and structure consistent, and remove any unused example rows.

sub_fields.label: Icon Class
sub_fields.name: icon_class
sub_fields.instructions: Use a supported Bootstrap Icons class, for example “bi-check-circle”. Confirm the icon is available in the front-end build.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: text
sub_fields.instructions: Explain the visitor benefit in plain language. Be specific about the workflow or outcome, and avoid jargon or unsupported claims.
sub_fields.default_value: A shared real estate data foundation across teams

description: Defaults are MRI-focused examples for a commercial real estate marketing landing page. Adapt to the campaign audience, product and region; verify every claim, customer reference and legal statement before publishing.
ai_description: Generate concise, benefit-led MRI Software landing-page copy. Emphasise open and connected real estate technology, connected leasing/finance/operations workflows, portfolio visibility and flexibility. Do not invent metrics, reviews, awards, prices, customer names or implementation timelines.
